subject: documentation re usage of HTML classes for reactive inputs

messages.author: b55e91b47a07d232
messages.subject: documentation re usage of HTML classes for reactive inputs
parts:
Hi:
For a variety of reasons I have a preference for defining my UI structures in HTML, for example <button>Do Something</button> rather than actionButton("doItBtn", "Do Something"). I just spent a couple hours however trying to get the following "button with observer" set-up  to work:

observe({ 
    input$segBtn1
    message("Button pressed")    
})

<button type="button" class="ctrlBtn" id="segBtn1" value="go">Gen</button>

I eventually discovered the problem was that the button classes must also include 'action-button' or the observer will never get triggered. My question is, did I miss some place in the documentation or tutorials where all these class dependencies are documented? If these sort of API stuff is not yet there, could it be added to the next rev of the doc?

Thanks

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: documentation re usage of HTML classes for reactive inputs
parts:
I prefer the HTML UI too for flexibility. I print the commands in my R console to discern the class structure expected by a component.

So actionButton("doItBtn", "Do Something") will give you

<button id="doItBtn" type="button" class="btn action-button">Do Something</button>

which tells you what the action-button expects.
